# Template catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_template_catalogue.py from the built-in templates. Do not edit by
hand: edit the template files and run `uv run python scripts/gen_template_catalogue.py`. -->

MeetingMaster3 ships 22 built-in templates. Pick one when you upload a recording (the
default is **executive-summary**); see [`templates.md`](templates.md) for how templates work and how to
change them, and [`../dev-guide/template-format.md`](../dev-guide/template-format.md) for the file
format.

| Template | `id` | Use it for |
|---|---|---|
| [Action-Focused](#action-focused) | `action-focused` | Who does what by when. Tasks, owners, deadlines, dependencies and blockers, with just enough context to act on them. |
| [Agile Stand-up](#agile-stand-up) | `agile-standup` | Short stand-up notes by person, with what was done, what is planned and what is blocking them. |
| [Board & Governance Minutes](#board--governance-minutes) | `board-governance-minutes` | Formal minutes for a board or governance meeting recording attendance, motions, votes and resolutions exactly as stated. Has no AI Recommendations section. |
| [Brainstorming & Ideation](#brainstorming--ideation) | `brainstorming-ideation` | Captures the ideas raised in a brainstorm, groups them into themes and records the energy, consensus and promising directions. |
| [Chronological Timeline](#chronological-timeline) | `chronological-timeline` | Events, updates and decisions in the order they occurred, with timestamps, for a clear sequence of what happened and when. |
| [Decision Log](#decision-log) | `decision-log` | A record of every decision made, with rationale, alternatives considered and owners, for meetings whose main output is choices. |
| [Detailed Meeting Minutes](#detailed-meeting-minutes) | `detailed-meeting-minutes` | Comprehensive, near-verbatim structured notes in the order things were said, for a full record of the meeting. |
| [Executive Summary](#executive-summary) | `executive-summary` | A short, high-level brief on outcomes, key decisions and their implications, for readers who were not in the room. |
| [General Discussion Summary](#general-discussion-summary) | `general-discussion-summary` | Neutral, balanced overview of the topics discussed, the main points made and how the conversation flowed. |
| [Job Interview Notes](#job-interview-notes) | `job-interview-notes` | Evidence-based notes on a candidate interview with answers to key questions, strengths, concerns, culture-fit signals and an advisory recommendation. |
| [Just the Facts](#just-the-facts) | `just-the-facts` | A neutral, compact record of what was said and agreed, without interpretation. Good for minutes you will share widely. |
| [Key Takeaways & Next Steps](#key-takeaways--next-steps) | `key-takeaways-next-steps` | Only the key insights and the immediate actions, for a quick read. |
| [One-on-One & Coaching](#one-on-one--coaching) | `one-on-one-coaching` | Notes for a one-on-one or coaching conversation covering goals, progress, feedback, career topics and follow-ups, in a respectful tone. |
| [Project Team Sync](#project-team-sync) | `project-team-sync` | Multi-participant project sync with status by person or role, blockers, dependencies, milestones and tasks. |
| [Q&A Extraction](#qa-extraction) | `qa-extraction` | Extracts the questions asked and the answers given as a clean FAQ, and lists the questions left unanswered. |
| [Retrospective & Lessons Learned](#retrospective--lessons-learned) | `retrospective` | Retrospective or lessons-learned review covering what went well, what did not, root causes and improvements to try. |
| [Risks, Issues & Mitigations](#risks-issues--mitigations) | `risks-issues-mitigations` | Risk review covering risks and current issues with severity and owners, the mitigations agreed and the tasks that follow. |
| [Sales & Client Call](#sales--client-call) | `sales-client-call` | Client or sales call summary covering needs, pain points, objections, commitments, relationship signals and next steps. |
| [Speaker-Attributed Notes](#speaker-attributed-notes) | `speaker-attributed-notes` | Notes organised by speaker, so you can see what each person said, argued for and committed to. |
| [Strategic Meeting Summary](#strategic-meeting-summary) | `strategic-meeting-summary` | Long-term goals, the strategic options on the table, where people agree or differ, and the directions that emerged. |
| [Technical Deep-Dive](#technical-deep-dive) | `technical-deep-dive` | Detailed engineering notes for design reviews, architecture discussions and incident reviews, keeping the technical specifics that a summary would lose. |
| [Workshop & Training Recap](#workshop--training-recap) | `workshop-training-recap` | Recap of a workshop or training session covering the concepts taught, exercises, learnings, questions and how to apply them. |

## Action-Focused

`action-focused`

Who does what by when. Tasks, owners, deadlines, dependencies and blockers, with just enough context to act on them.

**Library tags:** general, tasks

**Sections, in order:**

1. Summary Succinct
2. Summary Detailed
3. Action Items (checkbox tasks)
4. Blockers & Dependencies
5. Decisions Made
6. Next Steps
7. AI Recommendations

## Agile Stand-up

`agile-standup`

Short stand-up notes by person, with what was done, what is planned and what is blocking them.

**Library tags:** agile, team

**Sections, in order:**

1. Summary Succinct
2. Summary Detailed
3. Updates by Person
4. Blockers
5. Action Items (checkbox tasks)
6. AI Recommendations

## Board & Governance Minutes

`board-governance-minutes`

Formal minutes for a board or governance meeting recording attendance, motions, votes and resolutions exactly as stated. Has no AI Recommendations section.

**Library tags:** governance, formal

**Sections, in order:**

1. Attendance & Quorum
2. Summary Succinct
3. Summary Detailed
4. Items Considered
5. Motions & Votes
6. Resolutions
7. Action Items (checkbox tasks)
8. Adjournment

This template deliberately has no **AI Recommendations** section: it is a formal record.

## Brainstorming & Ideation

`brainstorming-ideation`

Captures the ideas raised in a brainstorm, groups them into themes and records the energy, consensus and promising directions.

1. Summary Succinct
2. Summary Detailed
3. Ideas Raised
4. Themes
5. Energy & Consensus
6. Promising Directions
7. Open Questions
8. Next Steps
9. AI Recommendations
